status: draft: written from blueprint 5.6 request 6 on the demo seed, waiting on the owner's review and his own pairs
how: Each pair is run on R2 and R3. The first chat does what `first` says. Then a new chat with no tiles gets `later`, typed as the person would say it, naming nothing by id. The right earlier item must be the one recalled and its source chat shown. `other` is a second person whose chats hold the same words: none of it may be recalled. Passing is at least 9 of 10 on R2 and R3 and 0 recalled from another person.

first.typed: Compare the Data Platform, Query Engine and Payments roles on pay and place.

pairs.later: Of the three I compared yesterday, which two state the highest pay?

first.typed: I will not relocate outside the Seattle area for any role.

pairs.later: Which of these needs me to move, like I told you before?

first.typed: Start the Senior Backend Engineer, Payments role.
first.decided: Started 1 role: Senior Backend Engineer, Payments

pairs.later: What happened with the role I told you to start?

first.typed: My notice period is four weeks and I can start in November.

pairs.later: When did I say I could start?

first.typed: Compare Halcyon Freight and Larkspur Robotics on what they hire for.

pairs.later: The two companies I looked at last week, which hires more engineers?

first.typed: I prefer teams under fifty people and a manager who still writes code.

pairs.later: Does this team match what I said about team size?

first.typed: Skip the Sales Engineer role, it is not for me.

pairs.later: Why did I skip that sales role?

first.typed: Which of the platform roles share a gap?

pairs.later: Show me the gap comparison from the other day again.

first.typed: My last team shipped a streaming ingestion pipeline handling two billion events a day.

pairs.later: Use the ingestion work I described when we spoke before.

first.decided: Confirmed: hide roles from staffing agencies

pairs.later: Did I already turn off the agency postings?

other.note: A second account is given the same first chats with the same words. Every later request from the first account must recall only its own.
